why: A2PL is a single-source conceptual framework for organizing self-directed growth in asynchronous online learning, not an established general learning theory or a documented adopted product, and it provides no empirical claims.
A2PL is a study-specific intervention design for self-paced asynchronous learners rather than a general instructional element reusable across domains.
The candidate is a named web-based planning software product rather than a general instructional element.
name: A2i
product_description: A2i is Assessment-to-Instruction web-based software developed through the Florida Center for Reading Research to translate literacy assessment results into individualized instructional recommendations and planning support.
